literal: Subjects having embraced, scepter who wields, great earth king's, feet having embraced, will stand world.
translation: The world will stand embracing the feet of the king of the vast earth, who wields his scepter while embracing his subjects.
modern: தன் குடிமக்களை அன்போடு அரவணைத்து செங்கோல் செலுத்தி ஆட்சி செய்யும் பெரிய நிலப்பரப்பை ஆளும் மன்னனின் அடிகளை உலக மக்கள் தழுவி நிற்பார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the reciprocal relationship between a just ruler and the people. The word 'தழீஇ' (having embraced) is used twice to highlight this mutual bond. First, the king rules by embracing his subjects, which means he governs with care and protects their welfare. In return, the world will stand embracing his feet, demonstrating their enduring loyalty and devotion to his righteous rule.
